headword: {結婚式場|けっこんしきじょう}

definitions.explanation: A commercial facility where weddings and the receptions that follow them are held. In Japan these are typically purpose-built businesses offering the ceremony, the banquet, catering, and dress rental as one package.

examples.japanese: {結婚式場|けっこんしきじょう}を{探|さが}している。
examples.english: We're looking for a wedding venue.

examples.japanese: {海|うみ}の{見|み}える{結婚式場|けっこんしきじょう}で{式|しき}を{挙|あ}げた。
examples.english: We held our ceremony at a wedding venue with an ocean view.

examples.japanese: {人気|にんき}の{結婚式場|けっこんしきじょう}は{一年前|いちねんまえ}から{予約|よやく}が{埋|う}まる。
examples.english: Popular wedding venues are booked up a year in advance.

examples.japanese: {結婚式場|けっこんしきじょう}の{見学|けんがく}に{行|い}って、{料理|りょうり}の{試食|ししょく}もさせてもらった。
examples.english: We went to view a wedding venue and they also let us taste the food.

notes:
{結婚式|けっこんしき} (wedding ceremony) + {場|じょう} (venue). Note the rendaku-free reading しきじょう.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {結婚式場|けっこんしきじょう}を{探|さが}す: to look for a wedding venue
- {結婚式場|けっこんしきじょう}を{予約|よやく}する: to book a wedding venue
- {結婚式場|けっこんしきじょう}の{見学|けんがく}: a venue viewing
- {式|しき}を{挙|あ}げる: to hold a wedding ceremony

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {披露宴会場|ひろうえんかいじょう}: reception hall — the banquet room specifically, not the ceremony space
- {会場|かいじょう}: venue — the general word for any event site
- {挙式|きょしき}: holding a ceremony — the act, used in booking language ({挙式|きょしき}{予定|よてい}{日|び})
